items.title: Sam Darnold: 'Feeling good' during Week 3 prep
items.description:
Darnold (glute) said Thursday that he's "feeling good" and aiming to play Sunday at Washington, but the Seahawks are taking the situation "day by day," John Boyle of the team's official site reports.
